content: TanStack Start official docs (tanstack.com/start/latest, Release Candidate): full-stack React framework built 100% on TanStack Router + Vite; adds full-document SSR, streaming, server routes/API routes, server functions, middleware, full-stack builds, universal deployment; docs explicitly state: if you know with certainty you will not need SSR/server features, consider TanStack Router alone (type-safe SPA routing). For a browser-only local-first app with no backend, Start's entire value-add (SSR, server functions, API routes) is unused; static/client-only mode exists but the framework is geared to server runtimes. Recommendation: use TanStack Router (or Start in client-only SSG mode per PRD pin) - validate in Phase 1 spike; the PROJECT.md already flags this as open.
